notes: porter declared unbuildable after 1 attempt(s): The recursion guest's provable body IS a jolt-core verifier invocation (JoltVerifierPreprocessing/RV64IMACProof/RV64IMACVerifier::verify), so it cannot be lifted without jolt-core, and jolt-core has no no_std path. Concretely: (1) jolt-sdk's feature chain is `guest-verifier = ["guest-std", "dep:common", "jolt-core/minimal"]` and `guest-std = [... "zeroos-std"] -> zeroos-runtime-musl`, i.e. the dependency itself forces the guest into std/musl mode; jolt-sdk is `#![cfg_attr(not(any(feature="host", feature="guest-std")), no_std)]`, so enabling guest-verifier makes jolt-sdk a std crate. (2) jolt-core/Cargo.toml states verbatim `# jolt-core needs std and rayon to compile` and `minimal = ["ark-ec/std", "ark-ff/std", "ark-std/std", "ark-ff/asm", "rayon"]`; jolt-core has no `#![no_std]`, uses std::sync/std::io/std::thread across 76+ files, and rayon requires OS threads, which a Jolt guest does not have. Making it no_std is a rewrite of the whole verifier crate, not I/O re-plumbing, and the only alternative (flipping the template to std/musl, as upstream's `program.set_std(true)` does) is explicitly forbidden because it changes the study target. Secondary, independent blockers, recorded for completeness: the frozen harness attribute `heap_size = 32768, max_trace_length = 65536` cannot host an in-guest Jolt verification (upstream configures heap_size = 134217728 and max_trace_length up to 67108864, max_input_size 2000000), and the program's only meaningful input is a multi-megabyte serialized (verifier-preprocessing || n || proof || device) blob produced by a full host-side proving run, plus build-script-generated `src/embedded_bytes.rs` and `src/provable_macro.rs` that are gitignored and absent from the corpus. No files were modified; the shared tree is left at the frozen template.
